# Extensions

Extensions add methods to existing types without modifying them.

## Coverage

- **Basic extensions**: Adding methods to structs, classes, interfaces
- **Extension methods**: Parameters, return types, chaining
- **Visibility rules**: Native vs anonymous vs named extensions
- **Interface implementation**: `extension T implements Interface { }`
- **Error cases**: Missing methods, wrong types

## Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `basic.md` | Basic extension declarations |
| `methods.md` | Extension method signatures |
| `visibility.md` | Extension visibility rules |
| `implements.md` | Extensions implementing interfaces |
| `errors.md` | Error cases |
